ValidationRule.description: Blueprint control: Requires at least one Competitor before advancing Opportunity to Negotiation stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation/Review') ), Competitor_Count__c = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At least one Competitor must be identified and added under Opportunity Competitors before advancing to the Negotiation stage.
